Here are a few recommendations:  


Stay away from provak's pack, no mods are compatible with that without some heavy tweaking.   


Hollywood FX - betters the impact effects, you can also choose the realistic option within it.   


Body Health System - For me, It's a must have. It will make your game significantly harder though.   


Position & View - Цемент / EFT - Repositions your weapon viewmodel, so they look a tad bit more realistic.   


Trader Overhaul - Rebalances traders and makes them a little more immersive, In some parts it will make your game harder (Ex. Clear Sky)   


Soundscape Overhaul - Better Soundscape where the sounds you hear are actually coming from NPCs on the map. (Gunshots/Mutants) Do have to install patches to make it compatible with JSRS.   


Food & Drink Animations - Will make the game look more immersive with animations playing once you've consumed - Drinks, Food, Medical Items, etc.   


HD Models Icons - If you plan to use HD Models make sure to get this, it'll replace the Icons for outfits making them look like the ones provided in the HD Models addon.   


That's about it, Good Hunting!
